- '**2026-09-08T21:29:29.994847** — Candidate cause added 2026-09-09 by youtube-digest
  (Agent Lightning v1.0, arXiv:2608.17528, via [[20260821-enterprise-ready-rl-for-ai-agents]])
  — not in causes 1-4 above: **text round-trip at the API boundary**. The harness
  keeps the *detokenized* assistant turn and re-sends text; vLLM re-tokenizes the
  whole prompt, so "append-only in characters" is not "append-only in token ids".
  Any token at a join that re-encodes differently (trailing whitespace/newline after
  assistant text, tool-call XML re-rendered from JSON rather than the tokens actually
  emitted, stripped reasoning_content) breaks the block hash from that point onward
  with no message edit at all. The paper''s transferable method is an **exact-token-continuation
  check at each call boundary**: assert the rebuilt prompt''s token prefix reproduces
  the previous request''s token ids, rather than asserting the message list was not
  rewritten. Worth running beside step 1''s per-iteration cached_tokens logging —
  it names the break position instead of only its cost. Live counter has worsened
  since filing: 5,097,760 / 88,119,712 = **57.85% since boot** (63.27% recent) vs
  68.7% on 2026-09-09 ~00:45 UTC.'
- '**2026-09-09T05:56:16.941384** — Triage 2026-09-09: CONFIRMED, live hit rate 61.75%
  (worse than filed 68.7%). Cause 1 confirmed empirically — cliff at iteration 8 (77.6%
  to 23.2%) across 41 sessions, 167 sessions analysed. Instrumentation from step 1
  already shipped in 5531f21. Split #603 #604 #605.'

- '**2026-09-09T07:00:54.086587** — **2026-09-09T07:0XZ — implemented in round SM_20260909_135140
  (commit `2677dea`).** Change: the keep-window is now applied once at turn entry
  (`_cap_history_reasoning`, `app/harness/loop.py:1220`, called at `:217`); the per-iteration
  `_prune_reasoning` call is gone, so the intra-turn message list is a strict extension
  of the previous request''s. `_prune_reasoning` itself and `harness.preserve_thinking_iterations`
  are untouched — config.yaml was not modified.


  **Mechanism confirmed on the live engine rather than inferred** (private prefix,
  salt `645e8b8c`, :8096 `primary`, max_tokens=1 so only prefill differs):


  | request over the same prefix | prompt | cached | rate |

  |---|---|---|---|

  | cold | 7965 | 0 | 0.0% |

  | warm, identical resend | 7965 | **0** | 0.0% |

  | strict extension | 7999 | 4800 | 60.0% |

  | reasoning popped from FIRST assistant msg | 7385 | **0** | 0.0% |

  | reasoning popped from LAST assistant msg | 7385 | 4800 | 65.0% |


  Same bytes of history, opposite outcomes: the position of the rewrite is the whole
  effect — earlier message, larger loss. That is the iteration-8 cliff with the mechanism
  attached. Row 2 also independently confirms this item''s own risk note ("`cached_tokens`
  reads 0 for the first two requests of any prefix on this engine"): an identical
  resend read 0 while the extension one message later read 4800, so single points
  off this counter are unreadable, only series.


  **Acceptance:** the per-iteration aggregate cannot be re-run meaningfully until
  ~24h of post-landing traffic exists, and the filter must not blend engine boots
  — filed as #618 with the script this needs. Contract''s other half (>=90% bar re-derived
  from the pre-cliff floor) is #603. Spawned: #617 (the preserve-thinking eval now
  measures the wrong arm), #618, #619.'
